Method of Attack: Malicious LNK shortcut file on USB drive executes PowerShell script explorer.ps1
PowerShell script downloads intermediary payloads hosted on legitimate platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Vimeo, Ars Technica) as encoded text strings
Intermediary payloads decode to URLs to download and install EMPTYSPACE malware downloader
EMPTYSPACE downloads QUIETBOARD backdoor and cryptocurrency miners

QUIETBOARD backdoor executes commands/scripts from C2 server, executes Python code, alters clipboard for cryptocurrency theft, infects USB/removable drives, captures screenshots, gathers system/network info, determines geographical location, establishes persistence, and supports dynamic modules
Impacted Systems: Systems infected via USB-based malware infection
Attack Vector: Malicious USB devices with LNK shortcut files
Abuse of legitimate online platforms to host intermediary payloads
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious LNK shortcut file on USB drive
Encoded payloads hosted on GitHub, GitLab, Vimeo, Ars Technica in user profiles or video descriptions
URLs decoded from intermediary payloads leading to EMPTYSPACE downloader
Communication with campaign's command and control (C2) server
